sentences.en: A midnight telephone call gives us both shock and displeasure.
sentences.zh: 午夜来电让我们俩都感到震惊和不悦。

sentences.en: Midnight is when ghosts are thought to walk the earth.
sentences.zh: 人们认为鬼魂在午夜时分会在地上游荡。

sentences.en: Get back before midnight or you will be locked out.
sentences.zh: 务必在午夜前回来，否则你会被锁在外面。
